independentMathematicalReview.reason: [a,b]^2 contains (r,c) exactly when [min(r,c),max(r,c)] is contained in [a,b]. Sort left ascending/right descending and keep strictly growing right endpoints: every discarded demand lies in a retained demand; retained left and right endpoints are strict.

Remove contained photos and photos assigned no demand. The remaining photo left/right endpoints have the same strict order. Assign each demand to its first covering photo: an inversion would force the earlier photo also to cover the earlier demand. Shrinking each assigned photo to its extreme demand endpoints keeps coverage and cannot increase union.

independentMathematicalReview.step: all union intersections reduce to previous photo
independentMathematicalReview.reason: For the new group [L(t+1),R(i)]^2, all earlier left endpoints are at most its left, and all earlier right endpoints are at most R(t). Each new/earlier intersection is therefore contained in the new/previous intersection. The exact union increment is new side squared minus max(0,R(t)-L(t+1)+1)^2. Triple overlap is consequently counted once.
Departure-only overlap constants cancel. All new edges in the nested-edge exchange are legal strict-forward edges.

If a shared cut has Q-prefix edge count one above P, swap suffixes there and both paths have q edges at unchanged total cost. Otherwise the first coordinate where Q internal cuts exceed P by two is Q-only d. Its previous Q cut b and enclosing P edge a->c satisfy a<=b<d<c and prefixQ(b)=prefixP(a)+1. Replacing a->c,b->d by a->d,b->c and exchanging tails makes two q-edge paths and does not increase their cost by the Monge identity. This proves 2F(q)<=F(q-1)+F(q+1), without relying on empirical convexity.

independentMathematicalReview.step: at most K versus exact after filtering
independentMathematicalReview.reason: Splitting a group yields two photos inside its previous photo, so union cannot increase; all q=1..B are feasible. Exact F(min(K,B)) equals the at-most-K optimum even with original duplicate/contained demands.

Nonincreasing integer savings F(q-1)-F(q) give an integer supporting penalty at each cardinality. At the first integer lambda choosing count<=K, K is itself an optimal penalized count, including jump/plateau cases. Thus G(lambda)-lambda*K is exact. At lambda=M^2, one-photo cost is at most 2*M^2 and every >=2-photo candidate is strictly larger since union is positive.

H=B+1 exceeds every feasible count, so H*(area+lambda*count)+count exactly orders cost then fewer photos. Strictly increasing filtered L makes slopes strictly decrease, and filtered R makes query x increase. Back deletion uses exact 128-bit intersection ordering; head deletion at equal values keeps a future-optimal lower slope without losing any primary/count tie. Each line enters and leaves at most once.

apiAndNumericReview.validation: Complete size/grid/K/coordinate validation precedes the two core scratch allocations; K is validated against original point count before clamping to filtered B. Empty input and out-of-contract integers reject; all inputs are const or by value and remain unchanged on success, invalid_argument and allocation failure.
apiAndNumericReview.state: All mutable state local; shared scratch resets head/tail/value for every penalty; no recursion except implementation sort stack. Internal penalized preconditions explicitly documented; it is not a checked public API.
apiAndNumericReview.integerReasoning: H<=100001. Each penalized prefix has a one-photo witness with cost<=2*M^2. Encoded saved values/intercepts have absolute value<5e17; slopes<3e11; intersection products<1e30<2^127. Casts to Wide happen before difference/product; start=-1 at L=0 is signed and safe. Count remainder is valid because final encoded DP value is nonnegative and count<H. Penalty*K<=1e17 is signed-64-safe.
apiAndNumericReview.complexity: O(N log N + N log(M+1)) time and O(N) auxiliary space; equivalently usual O(N log N+N log M) convention for M>=2. Hull workspace allocated once and reused. Each penalty pass is linear even when many lines are popped.
apiAndNumericReview.memory: On the tested ABI vector payload is 8*N+16*B<=2.4MB in the core; caller points excluded. By-value adapter adds input copies and the pair vector, total approximately4MB payload at N100000. RSS and sanitizer RSS are observed process measurements, not these payload formulas or official limits.
apiAndNumericReview.maximumAndExceptionCoverage: Supplied literal/structural maxima cover N100000/M1000000/K1..N, filtered B1, wide overlap, far coordinates, same-coordinate duplicates, arbitrary order, K-clamping, repeated calls, invalid extremes and bad_alloc recovery. New dilation checks create near-maximum coordinates with varied overlap boundaries.

suppliedCheckerIndependentReproduction.attribution: These 5427033 checks rerun the author checker and are reproduction, not a separate newly designed oracle. Normal and sanitizer are two executions of the same cases, not twice as many distinct cases.
suppliedCheckerIndependentReproduction.oracleReview: Read full checker: literal all-photo subsets form actual cell unions, pairwise containment is independent of production sorting, and generic square-union sweeps do not use the neighbor correction. Cubic exact-count DP and exhaustive penalty/fewer-count comparisons separately test the actual hull. Requested counts include original N when B is smaller. Allocation-failure counts are tested-toolchain observations.

newIndependentProbe.independence: A new structural lemma checker, not another implementation of the same DP: enumerate every strict interval chain with integer endpoints on grid sizes1..9, every partition, and every q-1/q+1 path pair; construct q/q paths by the specified branch. Costs come from literal 128-bit cell sets, not W or the DP. W is compared against those literal sets as a separate assertion. The public API is also compared against exhaustive literal partition minima. In addition, cell dilation [L,R]->[dL+t,d(R+1)+t-1] must scale optimum by d^2; reflected duplicates and contained requirements preserve it.
newIndependentProbe.limits: Partition oracle restricts photo choices to the normal form whose completeness was proved independently above; it does not replace the author all-arbitrary-photo-subset oracle on grids<=5. The finite exhaustive exchange checks support, but do not replace, the general Monge proof. Dilation reuses production on the base instance and is a metamorphic check, not an independent optimum oracle.
